newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - SRW wheat up, corn, soy steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - SRW wheat up, corn, soy steady.

text.p: FOB Gulf basis values for soft red winter wheat rose on Monday while corn and soybean positions were mostly steady.

Activity was fairly quiet but export sales for corn improved. USDA said private exporters reported sales of 110,000 tonnes of corn to unknown destinations for delivery during the 1996-97 marketing year. Egypt also bought 30,000 tonnes of Number 2 U.S. yellow corn for $164.65 per tonne C+F slated for October 1-10 delivery.
China bought at least one 50,000-tonne cargo of U.S. soymeal last week and Korea's Agricultural and Fishery Marketing Corp bought 20,000 tonnes of U.S. No 1 soybean at $338.27 per tonne, C and F.
Egypt purchased 100,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red wheat at $189.89 and $190.75 per tonne.
Dealers quoted the following afternoon FOB U.S. Gulf values, basis Chicago futures, except hard red winter wheat basis Kansas City. (In cents per bushel).
